Hero_Desc_Rim:
A phantom that protects the balance of Elias.
Whenever someone gets caught up in something big, she appears out of nowhere and lends a hand.
She has the most unique sense of humor among the phantoms.
Album_Like_Rim: Future friendships. Maintaining order between phantoms and all races in Elias.
Album_Hate_Rim: The quiet that comes with solitude. Her age.
Album_Wish_Rim: Hoping someone understands her sense of humor.
Album_Rim1: A phantom dwelling alone in a secluded tower from phantom society. Rim may seem aloof and brusque, but no phantom is as rational and logical as her.
Album_Rim2: Rim doesn't really get along with other phantoms because of her personality. In truth, it's not because she doesn't try to fit in. Rather it is because they seem to misunderstand her. She consoles herself by embracing her 'lone wolf' status.
Album_Rim3: It seems Rim gets along better with denizens from the other regions of Elias than with other phantoms. When asked if she ever thought of leaving her solitary tower to explore outside phantom society, she admitted being afraid of being ignored, worrying what happened in phantom society would happen elsewhere.
Album_Rim4: Though phantoms generally have strong personalities, making it difficult to get along with other denizens from other regions. Seeing Rim being so friendly with the denizens of the forest has led other phantoms to seek her advice. Gaining recognition from other phantoms, Rim appears to be happier than ever.
Album_Rim5: Rim treasures her scythe dearly, carrying it wherever she goes. She treats it as if it's her best friend.
Album_Rim6: Even with a closer look, Rim's scythe doesn't seem all that special in appearance. Confused, I asked why she cherishes it so. Her claim? Oddly, she says it moves on its own when no one's watching.
Album_Rim7: Ever since I asked Rim about her scythe, I've had the unsettling feeling of being watched whenever I'm alone. One day, I turned toward the window and saw a scythe standing there, staring at me. I jumped in shock, only to realize Rim had come over to visit. I told her to just come inside instead of standing by the window next time. But Rim insisted she was never standing by the window.
LoveHero_Rim:
Did my jokes
finally make you laugh?
LoveHeroCancel_Rim:
Cancelling a friend request?
Hmph. Not into that.
Food_ChefNote_Rim_Hate1:
After smelling the food, Rim seemed too uncomfortable to say anything. 
After a long time, she admitted the thought of eating it was too much to bear, saying the smell of gunpowder was too strong for her.
Food_ChefNote_Rim_Hate2:
Rim took a bite of the Mocharon but couldn't swallow it.
It seemed too sweet for her. She looked like she wanted to spit it out.
Food_ChefNote_Rim_Like1: Rim praised the dish for being delicate, and not overpowering, in flavor.
Food_ChefNote_Rim_Like2: After drinking the juice, Rim said it would be the perfect drink for when she's all alone at home and ended up buying a few more bottles.
Food_ChefNote_Rim_Like3: Rim slightly wrinkled her brow as if it was a bit sour by her standards but seemed satisfied with the sweet aftertaste.
Food_ChefNote_Rim_Like4: Unable to raise her head as she struggles to hold back her laughter, Rim softly spits out that the songpyeons are on her pun-side.
Food_ChefNote_Rim_Like5: She had to be stopped from packing it to count the powder when bored, and told to eat it first. She said she liked the sour and refreshing flavor.
Food_ChefNote_Rim_Like6: I had to hear Rim yelling out "I scream, you scream, give me all that cream..."
Food_ChefNote_Rim_Like7: Rim was about to say something odd about rice cakes... I quickly stuffed one on her mouth.
Food_ChefNote_Rim_Like8: Rim likes the bittersweet taste, saying, "This food is choco... and my jokes hit like loco..." And I had to endure her dad jokes.
Food_ChefNote_Rim_Like9: Right after eating, Rim started playing with words like "candy", "Candyce", "candydate"... I had to resist the urge to shut her up with a candy...cane.

Rim_Growth1_Skin3: A ghost growing little by little even in the chill. What chilling growth!
Rim_Growth2_Skin3: Hehe, I am all ready for our outing.
Rim_LevelUp_Skin3: Now I can travel even farther.

Rim_HeroUpgrade_Skin3: One more step today, toward a delightful outing.
Rim_Board_Skin3: Where shall we go this time?

Rim_Ultimate1: I cut down the seeds of chaos.
Rim_Gacha2: I am Rim, the Ghost of Order.
Rim_Line1: I leave this behind. A single rose.
Rim_Line2: The leisure of a cup of tea.
Rim_Line3: A fitting and suitably balanced feeling.
Rim_Lobby: Would you like to hear my humor?
LoveLetter_Rim: I used to live alone in a secluded house on a hill, but coming to the banquet hall has allowed me to make many friends. I'm tickled pink that there seem to be some who like my jokes. Are there more who are about that lemon tea life? I can't wait for my friends to come by my house someday. I'm grateful that the Master allowed me to meet many Apostles at the banquet hall.
LoveCall_Rim:
Hello, Master. It is Rim.
The reason I contacted you is none other than Rim. I-I am sorry. I did it again without thinking...
Anyway, I called because you suddenly came to mind while I was drinking a warm cup of tea.

In the past, I would have drunk tea alone in my lonely house atop the hill...
But since joining you, I have made so many friends that it had been a long time since I last drank tea by myself.
I was surprised to find that time which once would have felt lonely had become time to quietly arrange my thoughts.

To think I would become glad for a brief moment of solitude like this.
My former self could never have imagined it. That is why I wanted to thank you.
That is all. Thank you, Master.
Affinity_Rim_EP01_001: Sigh... Is there any way I can be friends with phantoms, my own kind...?
Affinity_Rim_EP01_003: Right...? None of them gets me...
Affinity_Rim_EP01_004: You don't have to limit yourself to phantoms. There are many others you can befriend.
Affinity_Rim_EP01_005: That's true... Still, it's a shame because they're my kind after all.
Affinity_Rim_EP01_006: If you really want to be friends with them, you should stop telling bad jokes.
Affinity_Rim_EP01_007:
*Cough...* Bad jokes...?!
That's part of who I am as a phantom! You're just incapable of appreciating my jokes, that's all!
Affinity_Rim_EP02_001: Hmm... Food and counseling in the banquet hall... how interesting.
Affinity_Rim_EP02_002: It's not counseling. We're just having a conversation.
Affinity_Rim_EP02_003: What? There's no counseling here? I'm gonna need to get some counseling for the lack of counseling here...
Affinity_Rim_EP02_004: Counseling? Why, is something on your mind?
Affinity_Rim_EP02_005: Not really... It's just pleasant to have someone to talk to after such a long while...
Affinity_Rim_EP02_006: The long-term goal for the banquet hall this year is to pack the Apostles' bellies to bursting!
Affinity_Rim_EP02_007:
Er... That was a joke? Please tell me no.
Ugh... I'm sorry, but even I have standards for jokes...
Affinity_Rim_EP03_001:
I see other phantoms have joined the Order, much like me...
Are you sure you can handle them, Master?
Affinity_Rim_EP03_002: I'm not sure, but the only way to know is to try.
Affinity_Rim_EP03_003: That's quite understandable since my kind likes to play tricks all the time.
Affinity_Rim_EP03_004: We're just recruiting anyone we can to fill seats.
Affinity_Rim_EP03_005: Th-That's your intent here...? Well... I guess I don't have anything to say to that, but...
Affinity_Rim_EP03_006: It's fine. If they lack faith, off to the Penitence Chamber they go.
Affinity_Rim_EP03_007:
The Penitence Chamber...? Wh-What happens there? Can I withdraw from the Order?
No, no... It's not that I lack faith...
Affinity_Rim_EP04_001:
I like the banquet hall because I can be friends with like-minded folks.
What a friendly place.
Affinity_Rim_EP04_002: That's not being friends. Everyone is just putting on a front and being polite.
Affinity_Rim_EP04_003: Wh-What did you say...? Uh... Urgh... Ughhh...
Affinity_Rim_EP04_004: That's exactly what this place is for. Take your time and have fun!
Affinity_Rim_EP04_005: Thank you, I'd better make a lot of friends and exchange plenty of jokes while I'm here, heh... Please pretend you didn't hear that.
Affinity_Rim_EP04_006: Did you pay to enter at the door?
Affinity_Rim_EP04_007:
Wh-What? P-Pay? You're joking, right...?
...Why aren't you answering me? Are you serious? B-But I don't have any money...!
Affinity_Rim_EP05_001:
The world is such a harsh place.
It just drops you off somewhere with no instructions on how to live life.
Affinity_Rim_EP05_002: You should learn to teach yourself.
Affinity_Rim_EP05_003: You have great mental fortitude, Master. I should learn from you.
Affinity_Rim_EP05_004: It can't be helped. No one asked to be born, yet here we are.
Affinity_Rim_EP05_005: Still, don't you think there must be someone who was born because they wanted to? If not, that would be sad.
Affinity_Rim_EP05_006: Stay positive and see everything as a new and different experience.
Affinity_Rim_EP05_007: So it's the way we view the world that is important? Thanks for the good advice.
Affinity_Rim_EP06_001: What do you think is more important? The talent you were born with, or the experience you gain as you mature?
Affinity_Rim_EP06_003: You're saying that we should balance the two, right? I agree.
Affinity_Rim_EP06_004: Effort alone can only get you so far without innate talent.
Affinity_Rim_EP06_005: But... what if no one appreciates your innate talent?
Affinity_Rim_EP06_006: It's through accumulated experience that talent is formed. Experience is important.
Affinity_Rim_EP06_007:
Still... It's too hard to improve myself through experience alone.
Sometimes I feel like I'm not even myself...
Affinity_Rim_EP07_001: I've been borrowing books from various places to read lately, and I've come across many helpful things.
Affinity_Rim_EP07_002: Reading is never a bad thing.
Affinity_Rim_EP07_003: Absolutely! I feel like I've been accumulating plenty of material for jokes.
Affinity_Rim_EP07_004: What have you been reading? Have you learned anything good?
Affinity_Rim_EP07_005: I read a book that talks about language. Rose rose to put rose roes on her rows of roses... heh!
Affinity_Rim_EP07_006: Please, don't tell me you've been reading some old joke books.
Affinity_Rim_EP07_007: ...What am I supposed to do if you shut me down like that from the get-go?
Affinity_Rim_EP08_001: Would phantoms benefit from exercise? It's not like we have muscles...
Affinity_Rim_EP08_002: Surely there must be SOME benefit? Give it a try and let me know how it goes.
Affinity_Rim_EP08_003: Got it. A phantom that's exercising... phantasizing for short... fantasizing... heh!
Affinity_Rim_EP08_004: They say exercising is good for your mental health as well...
Affinity_Rim_EP08_005: But I think my mind is healthy enough already... I doubt it can get any better.
Affinity_Rim_EP08_006: If you don't need to exercise, it's best not to. It's nothing but a tiresome activity.
Affinity_Rim_EP08_007: Really? You seem quite envious of me, Master. You could probably benefit from some exercise, couldn't you?
Affinity_Rim_EP09_002: Some say that asking something like this will actually end a friendship... A curse or something...
Affinity_Rim_EP09_003: Such a thing exists in your homeland, Master? It must be a frightening place for friendless phantoms...
Affinity_Rim_EP09_005: Haha... thank you. Now, I have a friend too. I'm so happy.
Affinity_Rim_EP09_006: You shouldn't categorize friends like that...
Affinity_Rim_EP09_007: Then how do you distinguish between a friend-friend and a friend you just know? This is difficult...
Affinity_Rim_EP10_001: Why are you staring at G like that?
Affinity_Rim_EP10_002: It's too big. Leave it in a locker.
Affinity_Rim_EP10_003: Huh? But... G moves on its own when no one is looking. Are you okay with that?
Affinity_Rim_EP10_004: Maybe you don't have friends because that thing is too scary?
Affinity_Rim_EP10_005: N-No way. G is a good scythe... That... can't be... can it...?
Affinity_Rim_EP10_006: It's bothering me for some reason. It looks familiar...
Affinity_Rim_EP10_007: You don't remember a scythe like this? "Cut" it out. Hehehe...
Affinity_Rim_EP11_001: What kind of tea do you like most, Master?
Affinity_Rim_EP11_002: It's hard to pick just one.
Affinity_Rim_EP11_003: Hmm... That's understandable. Take your time to think about tea. Your tea-time... Hehe...
Affinity_Rim_EP11_004: I drink any kind of tea just fine.
Affinity_Rim_EP11_005: Come visit my tower later for tea. I pride myself on my hospitaliTEA. ... Puhuhup!
Affinity_Rim_EP11_006: I prefer other drinks over tea.
Affinity_Rim_EP11_007: That's a shame. I was hoping I'd finally have a friend to enjoy tea with...
Affinity_Rim_EP12_001: Many other phantoms must visit this place too...? What do you usually talk about?
Affinity_Rim_EP12_003: That can't be right. The phantoms don't really like me very much...
Affinity_Rim_EP12_005: Typical phantoms, I suppose. Though my puns are no joke...
Affinity_Rim_EP12_007: Are phantoms generally that profound? How interesting.
Affinity_Rim_EP13_001: They say dreams are the opposite of reality... Is that really true?
Affinity_Rim_EP13_003: Espi won't even give me the time of day... Have I been bothering her too much? I'm sorry.
Affinity_Rim_EP13_005: But... isn't the concept of dreams becoming reality interesting?
Affinity_Rim_EP13_006: Dreams are the opposite of reality.
Affinity_Rim_EP13_007: Really? If I dream about being unpopular, would I become popular in real life?
Affinity_Rim_EP14_001: What kind of mindset do you need when eating alone in a bustling restaurant?

Affinity_Rim_EP14_005: Lurking against the wall... How gRIM... pffft.
Affinity_Rim_EP14_006: Don't worry about what others think and eat confidently.
Affinity_Rim_EP14_007: But I can't help feeling smaller with all the whispering around me...
Affinity_Rim_EP15_001: G seems to have no energy lately, so I'm worried...

Affinity_Rim_EP17_005: I already sent them, but no one came...
